APPEARANCE & ACCESSIBILITY
Theme
System

Navigation uses no continuous animation. The native task keeps its fixed acquisition presentation.
Profile display units
Metric
Imperial
Text outside acquisition follows system text scaling. Task requested sRGB colors, shape/text size, geometry and timing are fixed by its configuration. Physical luminance is unmeasured; the app does not override brightness.
Device permissions
Camera · eye-positioning preview
Browser permission is checked at eye preview
Bluetooth · find and connect to a reader
Unavailable in browser preview
Private record unlock
Web preview uses memory only
Viewing this page requests no permission. Bluetooth permission is requested only from Devices. Android 11 and earlier require the OS discovery location permission for Bluetooth scanning; the app does not collect location. No microphone, photo-library or notification permission is requested.
Refresh permission status
Help & diagnostics
Reader connection: check Bluetooth access, power and distance, then request a fresh scan. A simulator connection does not qualify a sensor.
Offline records: unlock the current workspace to view local saves. Upload only queues after your explicit choice; Pending sync shows requested delivery.
Unavailable capture: read Service status for the reason. Export and deletion are in Privacy & data; a pending request is not a completed request.
